chapters: Attract, develop, and retain top talent

evidence.activity: Employee resource groups run as an employee-led program built on community service, business impact, career development and education pillars
evidence.quote: Our ERGs are catalysts for engagement and impact.
evidence.section: Nurture our people and communities > Engage our people and communities > Employee resource groups (ERGs)

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: employee networks with no membership figures

evidence.activity: iHope philanthropic program providing in-kind genomic testing for children with suspected genetic disease in underserved regions, run through a global network of affiliated clinics
evidence.quote: Launched by Illumina in 2017 , iHope is a philanthropic initiative designed to expand access to clinical genomic testing and care for children with suspected genetic diseases in underserved regions worldwide.
evidence.indicators: 25 clinics across 13 countries; more than 3,000 clinical cases

cross_cultural.criterion: level 3: named program serving underserved communities, with reach figures

evidence.activity: Annual pay equity review that keeps a zero net pay gap across gender, ethnicity and race
evidence.quote: We are proud to have reached this milestone early—and as of 2025, we have maintained a zero net pay gap for seven consecutive years.
evidence.section: Nurture our people and communities > Attract, develop, and retain top talent > Pay equity and transparency
evidence.indicators: zero net pay gap; seven consecutive years

evidence.activity: Fertility benefit program covering employees pursuing nontraditional paths to parenthood
evidence.quote: Through our partner Progyny, we offer a comprehensive fertility benefit program to eligible US-based employees that covers fertility preservation, providing access to care for our employees, including those pursuing nontraditional paths to parenthood.
evidence.section: Nurture our people and communities > Employee benefits > Supporting growing families

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: inclusive benefits, limited reach disclosed

cross_cultural.reason: Level 3: iHope is a named, current program that removes access barriers for underserved communities, with reach figures (25 clinics across 13 countries, more than 3,000 clinical cases). Internal practices support it: ERGs with no membership figures, a zero net pay gap across gender and ethnicity, and inclusive fertility benefits. Customer or community access is not a major business line with measured reach, so the score does not reach 4.

ai.notes: The 10-K's human capital section is mostly general belonging language and points to the Corporate Responsibility Report, so cross_cultural was rescored using the 10-K and the report together. The level 3 score rests on treating iHope (in-kind sequencing for children in underserved regions) as customer_access for underserved communities. This is borderline because the program centres on health access rather than cultural or linguistic inclusion; if a reviewer disagrees, the score falls to 2 (ERGs and inclusive practices without figures). iHope is now scaled through partner Genetic Alliance after nearly a decade run through Illumina laboratories, and Illumina continues to provide in-kind support, so it is marked current. Two items were deliberately not counted: the 250,000+ genomes from ancestrally diverse cohorts (AGD/UK Biobank), which is a research output rather than an inclusion program, and Illumina's support for bringing researchers from low- and middle-income countries to the Undiagnosed Hackathon, which was a one-off event. The equal-opportunity policy language is boilerplate and was not scored. The quoted figures and workforce regional counts do not count as activities.
